description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 20.02.2017 to 26.02.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance. It establishes new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges, which is a regulatory function. This falls under the "Legal/Regulatory" category (Type 5) as it constitutes a statutory instrument that modifies how existing laws and regulations are applied.
